title: Prevent Resolve Improve 26-30 Government Debt Management Strategy
text:
The 26-30 Government Debt Management Strategy aims to further improve the approach to the resolution of debt owed to government through a focus on: 

 • 
 preventing avoidable debt,  

 • 
 resolving debt to clear standards, and  

 • 
 improving government capability to resolve debt efficiently, effectively and fairly.

 It also sets out the role of the GDMF functional centre in driving a focus on data, capability in terms of skills and technology and more bespoke support for specific debt types. 

 For more guidance on debt management, please contact the Government Debt Management Function:  gdmfcentre@hmtreasury.gov.uk .
changeNote: The 23-26 Government Debt Strategy has been replaced by the 26-30 Government Debt Management Strategy.
